articles.title: Opinion: Prediction markets exploit financially vulnerable Gen Z
articles.summary: Some talking head is upset that Gen Z is gambling away tuition money on prediction markets instead of, presumably, investing in index funds like a responsible adult. If regulators start seeing prediction markets as predatory gambling rather than legitimate price discovery mechanisms, the whole industry gets a lot harder to operate in the US.

articles.title: Polymarket upgrades $25 referral code “OREGON” for NFL Week 11
articles.summary: Polymarket rolled out a new referral code for NFL Week 11 that bumps the sign-up bonus from the standard offer to $25. The move suggests the platform is aggressively competing for new volume during peak betting season when casual bettors are most likely to jump in.

articles.title: Best NFL prediction market promos for NFL Week 11: Get up to $590 in bonuses
articles.summary: Week 11 is here and the sportsbooks are throwing $590 bonuses at anyone willing to open an account and place some bets. If you're shopping around for the best welcome offers, the margins between books are wider than usual this week, which means your first $100 actually matters.

articles.title: One Tap Away From Addiction: The Prediction Market Risk for Gen Z
articles.summary: Gen Z is getting hooked on prediction markets with the same velocity that previous generations adopted slot machines, except now the dopamine hit arrives through a smartphone app instead of a casino floor. If regulators start cracking down on market accessibility for under-25s, the entire retail trading boom that's propped up platforms like Polymarket could face serious headwinds.

articles.title: As prediction markets grow, so do the number of short sellers counting on DraftKings to fall
articles.summary: DraftKings is getting shorted more heavily as prediction markets expand, suggesting investors are betting against the sportsbook giant's ability to capitalize on the sector's growth. If shorts are right, it signals that prediction market adoption might be cannibalizing DraftKings' core betting business faster than the company can pivot.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are gearing up for a leadership shake-up, with Van Hollen publicly signaling the race for top dog is legitimately competitive despite Schumer's current market dominance. For bettors, this is the kind of "respected insider says it's wide open" comment that either precedes a massive shift in odds or gets immediately priced in, so watch whether money actually moves on Van Hollen's words or if the market's already called his bluff.

articles.title: Grammys Album of the Year Prediction Market: Rosalia’s ‘Lux’ Leads
articles.summary: Rosalia's "Lux" is currently the betting favorite to win Album of the Year at the upcoming Grammys, edging out the competition in prediction markets. Music awards carry surprising predictive power for broader cultural moments, so tracking these markets early can reveal which artists are building real momentum versus riding hype.

articles.title: State and federal battle over prediction markets regulation heats up after midterms
articles.summary: The midterms lit a fire under state and federal regulators, who are now duking it out over who gets to control the prediction markets industry. If Washington wins this turf war, we're looking at national standards that could either legalize these markets or strangle them in red tape.

articles.title: Administration tries to intervene after Kalshi is threatened with restraining order - ABC News
articles.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, is facing legal threats from someone (likely a regulator or competitor) while the Biden administration reportedly tries to block the restraining order. If a restraining order sticks, it could hobble the fastest-growing prediction market in the US right when political betting is about to explode.

articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few US-regulated prediction market exchanges, is scrambling to comply with or challenge a New York state order that threatens to shut down its operations. If regulators succeed in booting them out of New York, the entire US prediction market industry loses its most aggressive player and potential mainstream credibility.

articles.title: States Begin Taxing Prediction Markets, but Revenue Is Uncertain
articles.summary: States are slapping taxes on prediction market winnings, turning what used to be a regulatory gray zone into actual revenue streams. That's going to make the economics of trading on these platforms noticeably worse for anyone serious about consistent profits.

articles.title: How the 2026 Midterms Played Out on Kalshi and Polymarket
articles.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket's users bet heavily on the 2026 midterm elections, and the results reveal how prediction market traders actually predicted the outcome before traditional polls got there. These platforms are quietly becoming the canary in the coal mine for political forecasting, and Wall Street is definitely paying attention.
